results.question: Consider the average difference between K-12 enrollment and 15-17 enrollment of schools that are locally funded, list the names and DOC type of schools which has a difference above this average.

WITH locally_funded AS (
    SELECT
        s.School,
        s.DOCType,
        f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS enrollment_difference
    FROM frpm AS f
    JOIN schools AS s
        ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
    WHERE f.`Charter Funding Type` = 'Locally Funded'
),
average_difference AS (
    SELECT AVG(enrollment_difference) AS avg_difference
    FROM locally_funded
)

FROM locally_funded
WHERE enrollment_difference > (SELECT avg_difference FROM average_difference)
